verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention policies, retention periods, candidate data deletion, or purge or erasure controls, whether in the UI or the API. The generic API claim of "full control over your data" does not describe a retention or deletion capability. Data retention is a fair axis for a recruiting platform that holds candidate PII, so the absence of evidence is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
